1.web: Why do you stand far off, Yahweh? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?
1.asv: Why standest thou afar off, O Jehovah? Why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

2.web: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.
2.asv: In the pride of the wicked the poor is hotly pursued; Let them be taken in the devices that they have conceived.

3.web: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy, and condemns Yahweh.
3.asv: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, And the covetous renounceth, yea, contemneth Jehovah.

4.web: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.
4.asv: The wicked, in the pride of his countenance, saith, He will not requireit. All his thoughts are, There is no God.

5.web: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is haughty, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.
5.asv: His ways are firm at all times; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight: As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.

6.web: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
6.asv: He saith in his heart, I shall not be moved; To all generations I shall not be in adversity.

7.web: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.
7.asv: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression: Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

8.web: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
8.asv: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; In the secret places doth he murder the innocent; His eyes are privily set against the helpless.

9.web: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless, when he draws him in his net.
9.asv: He lurketh in secret as a lion in his covert; He lieth in wait to catch the poor: He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him in his net.

10.web: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.
10.asv: He croucheth, he boweth down, And the helpless fall by his strong ones.

11.web: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”
11.asv: He saith in his heart: God hath forgotten; He hideth his face, he will never see it.

12.web: Arise, Yahweh! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.
12.asv: Arise, O Jehovah; O God, lift up thy hand: Forget not the poor.

13.web: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account?”
13.asv: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God, And say in his heart, Thou wilt not requireit?

14.web: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.
14.asv: Thou hast seenit; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: The helpless committeth himself unto thee; Thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.

15.web: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.
15.asv: Break thou the arm of the wicked; And as for the evil man, seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

16.web: Yahweh is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.
16.asv: Jehovah is King for ever and ever: The nations are perished out of his land.

17.web: Yahweh, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,
17.asv: Jehovah, thou hast heard the desire of the meek: Thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear;

18.web: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.
18.asv: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, That man who is of the earth may be terrible no more.
